ark_plus_shenzhen.protocol_note: Reported by the Ark+ authors for Shenzhen under their own multi-dataset pretraining and evaluation protocol. Shenzhen is one of the Ark+ pretraining tasks, so this is public same-task context, not a matched baseline for HealthRouter's five-fold out-of-fold probes.

imagenet_finetune_shenzhen.protocol_note: Reported only to document the seed draft's attribution error; this is the ImageNet fine-tuning baseline in Ark+ Supplementary Table 4, not Ark+'s result.

pcam_ensemble.protocol_note: Reported same-task context only; training budget, ensemble construction, checkpoint selection, and duplicate policy are not matched to the released HealthRouter audit.

bar_unet_kvasir.protocol_note: Reported same-dataset context under a different split, multi-seed training protocol, architecture, and evaluator.

sam2_rfanet_kvasir.protocol_note: Reported same-dataset context under a different split, training protocol, architecture, and evaluator.

li_segpnet_cvc.protocol_note: Reported dataset-specific training and evaluation context, not an unretrained Kvasir-to-CVC transfer result.

order_dr_aptos.protocol_note: Reported same-dataset context with locked validation-selected splits, unlike HealthRouter's incomplete local mirror and random split.

mammo_clustering_cbis.protocol_note: Reported same-dataset context under a different multiview protocol and data lineage.

transparent_pipeline_cbis.protocol_note: Reported same-dataset context on selected images under a different subset, conversion lineage, and model target.
